analysis: Before the substring call, versionStr has been guaranteed non-null and non-empty by earlier checks. The variable spaceIdx is obtained by calling indexOf(" ") on versionStr. The substring call is only executed if spaceIdx >= 1. In that call, beginIndex is 0 and endIndex is spaceIdx. Since spaceIdx >= 1, beginIndex (0) is not greater than endIndex. Also, spaceIdx is the index of a space character inside versionStr, so it is always less than the length of versionStr. Therefore endIndex (spaceIdx) is never larger than the string length, and beginIndex is not negative. Hence all conditions that would cause an IndexOutOfBoundsException are avoided by the preceding checks.
remark: The only declared exception is IndexOutOfBoundsException. In the given context, this exception cannot occur because: (1) beginIndex is 0, which is non-negative; (2) spaceIdx is derived from indexOf(" ") and is guaranteed to be less than the string length, so endIndex is never larger than the string length; (3) beginIndex (0) is not greater than endIndex (spaceIdx >= 1). Thus there is no scenario where the substring call would throw IndexOutOfBoundsException.
